moments.title: US Open Tennis Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The final Grand Slam of the year, the US Open, begins its Fan Week today with qualifying rounds and mixed doubles, leading into the main draw starting August 30th in New York.

angles.name: Grand Slam Fever
angles.copy: Ready for some Grand Slam drama? The US Open kicks off its Fan Week today, with the main draw proper starting Sunday. Who are you backing for glory in New York?

angles.name: Tennis Action Starts
angles.copy: The hard courts of Flushing Meadows are calling! US Open tennis action begins today with qualifying matches. Get ready for two weeks of incredible tennis.

moments.title: Reading & Leeds, Creamfields This Weekend
moments.blurb: Two of the UK's biggest music festivals, Reading & Leeds and Creamfields, are happening this Bank Holiday weekend, running from Thursday, August 27th to Sunday, August 30th.

angles.name: Festival Frenzy
angles.copy: Bank Holiday weekend means festival season peaks! Reading & Leeds and Creamfields are upon us. Who are you seeing, or where are you heading for your August Bank Holiday music fix?

angles.name: Rock or Rave?
angles.copy: The big one! Whether you're pitching a tent for rock anthems at Reading/Leeds or raving all weekend at Creamfields, it's going to be huge. Let us know your festival highlights!

moments.title: New UK Singles Chart Countdown
moments.blurb: The Official UK Singles Chart for the week ending September 2nd will be announced this Friday, August 28th, with Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' currently at No.1 and HUGEL/Imael Angel/Ultra Nate's 'Movin' To The Sun' challenging for the top spot.

angles.name: Chart Battle
angles.copy: Who's going to be UK No.1 this Friday? Sam Fender & Olivia Dean are holding strong, but HUGEL's 'Movin' To The Sun' is making a big push. Place your bets!

angles.name: Madonna & Kylie Collab
angles.copy: Madonna and Kylie Minogue's 'Love Sensation' is still making waves on the Official Singles Chart. Two legends, one track – what a combo!

moments.title: August Bank Holiday Weekend
moments.blurb: The August Bank Holiday in England, Wales, and Northern Ireland falls on Monday, August 31st, marking a three-day weekend for many.

angles.name: Long Weekend Vibes
angles.copy: Three-day weekend incoming! The August Bank Holiday is next Monday. What are your plans for soaking up the last of the summer? #BankHoliday

angles.name: Bank Holiday Escape
angles.copy: Just one week until the August Bank Holiday! Planning a staycation or a last-minute getaway? Tell us where you're heading!

moments.title: Happy 78th Birthday, Jean-Michel Jarre
moments.blurb: French electronic music pioneer Jean-Michel Jarre, known for his groundbreaking albums like 'Oxygène' and spectacular outdoor concerts, turns 78 today.

angles.name: Electronic Legend
angles.copy: Sending huge birthday wishes to the legendary Jean-Michel Jarre, who turns 78 today! From 'Oxygène' to epic live shows, his impact on electronic music is immense.

angles.name: Synthesizer Maestro
angles.copy: Happy 78th Birthday to the master of synthesizers, Jean-Michel Jarre! What's your favourite electronic masterpiece from this iconic artist?

moments.title: Billy Ray Cyrus Turns 65
moments.blurb: American country music star and actor Billy Ray Cyrus, famed for 'Achy Breaky Heart' and 'Old Town Road', celebrates his 65th birthday tomorrow, August 25th.

angles.name: Country Icon's Birthday
angles.copy: Tomorrow, Billy Ray Cyrus turns 65! From 'Achy Breaky Heart' to his recent collaborations, he's a true country icon. What's your favourite Billy Ray track?

angles.name: Happy 65th Billy Ray
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 65th Birthday to Billy Ray Cyrus for tomorrow! Still got that mullet magic.

moments.title: Shirley Manson of Garbage Turns 60
moments.blurb: Scottish singer-songwriter Shirley Manson, the distinctive lead vocalist of alternative rock band Garbage, will celebrate her 60th birthday on Wednesday, August 26th.

angles.name: Garbage Frontwoman's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 60th Birthday to the iconic Shirley Manson from Garbage this Wednesday! Her fierce vocals and attitude defined a generation of alt-rock.

angles.name: Alt-Rock Queen
angles.copy: Celebrating the incredible Shirley Manson, who turns 60 on Wednesday! What's your go-to Garbage track?

moments.title: Shania Twain's 61st Birthday
moments.blurb: The 'Queen of Country Pop', Shania Twain, known for hits like 'Man! I Feel Like a Woman!' and 'That Don't Impress Me Much', turns 61 on Friday, August 28th.

angles.name: Country Pop Queen
angles.copy: Happy 61st Birthday to the one and only Shania Twain this Friday! Still impressing us much with her incredible career. What's your favourite Shania anthem?

angles.name: Still The One
angles.copy: She's still the one! Shania Twain celebrates her 61st birthday on Friday. Get ready to sing along to her greatest hits all day long.

moments.title: Florence Welch Turns 40
moments.blurb: Florence Welch, the captivating lead singer of Florence + The Machine, known for her powerful vocals and ethereal style, celebrates her 40th birthday on Friday, August 28th.

angles.name: Happy 40th Florence
angles.copy: Wishing a magical 40th Birthday to Florence Welch this Friday! Her voice and artistry continue to enchant. What's your favourite Florence + The Machine track?

angles.name: Florence + The Machine
angles.copy: The incredible Florence Welch hits the big 4-0 on Friday! Celebrate the voice behind Florence + The Machine with us.

moments.title: Jack Black Celebrates 57
moments.blurb: Actor, comedian, and Tenacious D frontman Jack Black, known for his energetic performances in films like 'School of Rock' and his rock comedy, turns 57 on Friday, August 28th.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Jables
angles.copy: It's Jack Black's 57th birthday this Friday! From hilarious movies to Tenacious D rock anthems, he truly is a legend.

angles.name: Rock & Roll Comedian
angles.copy: Raise your horns for Jack Black, celebrating his 57th on Friday! What's your favourite Jack Black movie or Tenacious D song?

moments.title: Debbie Gibson Turns 56
moments.blurb: American singer-songwriter and 80s pop icon Debbie Gibson, who was the youngest female artist to write, produce, and perform a Billboard Hot 100 #1 single, celebrates her 56th birthday on Monday, August 31st.

angles.name: 80s Pop Princess
angles.copy: Happy 56th Birthday to the original 80s pop princess, Debbie Gibson, this Bank Holiday Monday! 'Electric Youth' forever!

angles.name: Foolish Beat at 56
angles.copy: Celebrating Debbie Gibson's 56th birthday on Monday! Her impact on pop music is undeniable. What's your favourite track from her?

moments.title: Gloria Estefan Turns 69
moments.blurb: Cuban-American superstar Gloria Estefan, known as the 'Queen of Latin Pop' and for her work with Miami Sound Machine, will celebrate her 69th birthday on Tuesday, September 1st.

angles.name: Queen of Latin Pop
angles.copy: Get on your feet and celebrate! The incredible Gloria Estefan turns 69 on Tuesday. Her music still makes us want to dance!

angles.name: Happy 69th Gloria
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 69th birthday to the iconic Gloria Estefan next Tuesday! What's your all-time favourite Miami Sound Machine hit?

moments.title: Barry Gibb Turns 80
moments.blurb: Sir Barry Gibb, the legendary singer-songwriter and co-founder of the Bee Gees, known for his distinctive falsetto and incredible songwriting, celebrates his 80th birthday on Tuesday, September 1st.

angles.name: Bee Gees Legend's 80th
angles.copy: Happy 80th Birthday to the one and only Sir Barry Gibb next Tuesday! A true music legend whose songs continue to soundtrack our lives. What's your favourite Bee Gees track?

angles.name: Stayin' Alive at 80
angles.copy: The iconic Barry Gibb celebrates his 80th birthday next week! From disco anthems to timeless ballads, his voice is unmistakable.
